description:
Propose access points (people, organisations, places) and dates for one record.

    Read the record with get_record first. Propose only what its text, or a
    reliable source you name, supports; give the evidence and source URLs for
    each. For a person or organisation, also give dates_of_existence, a short
    history and places when the record or a source states them: they pre-fill
    the new authority record if the archivist creates one. Look names and places
    up with search_authorities first; when one is already in the catalogue, give
    its id as existing_id and why in link_reason, and the archivist sees it as
    the first candidate to link. Nothing on the record
    changes: an archivist reviews every proposal.
    On AtoM with the AHG extensions they are queued in AI > NER review; on stock
    AtoM they are returned for the archivist to apply. Needs the archivist's own
    staff key.

dates_of_existence.description: Person or organisation only: life or existence dates for a new authority record, e.g. "1874-1949".
dates_of_existence.title: Dates Of Existence

evidence.description: Where in the record, or which source, supports it.
evidence.title: Evidence

existing_id.description: Id from search_authorities of the existing record this most likely is (not for dates).
existing_id.title: Existing Id

history.description: Person or organisation only: a short biographical or administrative history, from the record or a named source.
history.title: History

link_reason.description: With existing_id: why it is the same person, organisation or place, e.g. matching dates or places.
link_reason.title: Link Reason

places.description: Person or organisation only: places associated with them, separated by semicolons.
places.title: Places

sources.description: URLs of web sources used, if any.
sources.title: Sources

value.description: As it should appear: a name, a place, or a date such as "1954" or "1938-1945".
value.title: Value

name: propose_access_points_and_dates
